faqs.q: How do I convert a Word document to Markdown?
faqs.a: Drag a .docx file onto the page (or click to browse). Word to Markdown converts it in your browser and shows the Markdown instantly — copy it or download a .md file.
Yes. It is completely free and open source — no sign-up, no file limits, and no ads.

faqs.q: Are my documents uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your files never leave your device and are never uploaded, stored, or logged.

faqs.q: How do I convert a Google Doc to Markdown?
faqs.a: In Google Docs, choose File → Download → Microsoft Word (.docx), then drop that .docx into Word to Markdown.
Headings, bold and italic text, ordered and nested lists, tables, links, and code are converted to clean, GitHub-flavored Markdown.
